response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), stats AS (SELECT *, AVG(instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg, AVG(instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS group_avg FROM joined) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / NULLIF(group_avg, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_group_avg, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM stats WHERE instownpct > overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average ownership and the per-order-type averages are computed over the joined rows (matched, non-null ordertypedist, non-null instownpct), so rows with missing ownership are excluded from every average and from the filter.
'Cases' means each matched sentiment row (one row per sentreg); no further deduplication is applied.
The ratio is each row's ownership divided by the average ownership of its order type group, then averaged across rows above the overall average (not a ratio of averages).
